levels.name: Street / platform level (station hall, kiosk hall, platforms, west wing Kauppakuja)
other_names: Laituritaso is used only for the metro
levels.note: Platforms 1–19 are at street level; 4–11 are under the main roof, 1–3 east, 12–19 west (Wikipedia). Entrances from Rautatientori, Kaivokatu, Asema-aukio and Elielinaukio. The step-free route to the platforms is through the Elielinaukio gateway/corridor (porttikongi) and is signposted.

levels.name: Kellaritaso (basement: passenger service facilities — toilets, luggage lockers, lost property) / Asematunneli
other_names: Asematunneli (the 1967 shopping tunnel under Kaivokatu to the metro; HKL map level -1)
levels.note: paarautatieasema.fi names the basement level 'kellaritaso'/'kellarikerros'; reached by lift (step-free) or stairs. HKL's metro map names the -1 level 'Asematunneli', -2 'Kompassitaso', -3 metro 'Laituritaso'. The Eliel underpass and Kaisantunneli under the tracks are also on OSM layer -1. VR mentions 'the metro level on the K floor' for a TalletusOtto.
levels._source: https://paarautatieasema.fi/p/77/palvelut/matkustajapalvelutilat, read 2026-10-30; https://paarautatieasema.fi/p/79/palvelut/yleiso-wc, read 2026-10-30; HKL/Helsinki metro station guide map 'Rautatientori' (https://www.hel.fi/static/hkl/metroasema_opaskartat/rautatientori.pdf), read 2026-10-30; https://vr.fi/en/railway-stations-and-routes/helsinki, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-HKI.json), read 2026-10-30

open: Lifts to platforms 1–4 and 11–18: Wikipedia says the Eliel underpass has lifts to all tracks, but OSM maps platform lifts only for 5/6, 7/8, 9/10 and 19, and no owner page lists them. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: Geometry settles the mapped lifts: 5/6, 7/8, 9/10 and 19 (two nodes). For platforms 1–4 and 11–18, OSM has no lift within 3 m. n4642563726 (-1;0) is in the underpass corridor 5.3 m from platform 11. Lifts to 1–4 and 11–18 are not settled. Missing: owner text or a plan.]
Which underpass VR's 'northern underpass' (closed 22:30 Fri–Sun and before holidays, opens 05:30) is — the Eliel underpass is assumed but not stated.

Exact positions inside the station for most restaurants/services: paarautatieasema.fi gives only Kaivokatu 1 / Elielinaukio 3; positions come from OSM. Picnic, MFix, SIXT, PostNord machine and the VR Customer Point are not in OSM (no position).
R-kioski Asema-aukio and Kioskihalli were matched to OSM n317551811 / n317551808 by position (15–20 m off); check.
VR's 'K floor' (TalletusOtto on the metro level) is not defined in any owner source; HKL's map names levels Asematunneli/Kompassitaso/Laituritaso.
No official station floor plan from paarautatieasema.fi found; HSL area map (2020) predates Kaisantunneli.
Heights of levels: no source measures them.

Out of scope / left out: Asematunneli and Kompassitaso shops (metro level), R-kioski Scandic Grand Central (Bergbominkuja 4, hotel building), Hotel Scandic Grand Central, Fabrik and Bauer Media (offices).

answers.question: (no open-question list for Finland yet; brief priority 1: levels, which platforms have stairs/lifts, entrances, hours; metro transfer entrance and lift)
answers.answer: Platforms 1–19 at street level (Digitraffic, Wikipedia). Under the tracks: the Eliel underpass (1999–2000, stairs and lifts to all tracks per Wikipedia; OSM maps lifts for 5/6, 7/8, 9/10 and 19) and Kaisantunneli (2024). Basement 'kellaritaso' holds toilets (1.10 EUR, 06-24), lockers (06-24) and lost property, reached by lift or stairs. Metro transfer: step-free via the outdoor lift at the separate metro entrance on Asema-aukio (OSM 'Metro Rautatientori A'). Station open 05-02; hours for all 15 restaurants and the services are from paarautatieasema.fi or the shop's own site.
